description: Heroicons v2 for Svelte 5: every 24px icon in the outline and solid styles, rendered through one typed <Icon name="..."> component or imported as tree-shakeable components like BeakerIcon.
rules: Install @krowten/svelte-heroicons. The main API is one component: import { Icon } from '@krowten/svelte-heroicons', then <Icon name="beaker" />. There is no @heroicons/svelte package.
name takes heroicons v2 names such as arrow-up-tray or magnifying-glass, typed as IconName. Heroicons v1 names such as logout or search do not exist; look up the v2 name on heroicons.com.

Icon includes every icon (about 65 KB gzipped). When bundle size matters, import single icons as components: import { BeakerIcon } from '@krowten/svelte-heroicons'. The component name is the v2 name in PascalCase plus Icon (arrow-up-tray → ArrowUpTrayIcon).
Pass solid for the filled style: <Icon name="beaker" solid />. Only the 24px outline and solid styles are included, not the 20px mini or 16px micro ones.
Icons render at 24x24 by default; size them with CSS, e.g. class="size-5", and color them with text color, since they use currentColor.
Icons are aria-hidden by default; give an icon that carries meaning an aria-label and it is exposed as role="img".
